# FusionTik TikTok Downloader

> FusionTik (https://fusiontik.vercel.app) is a high-speed, free online TikTok downloader. Save TikTok videos without watermark in HD MP4, extract background music as MP3 audio, and download TikTok Photo Mode (carousel) slides as original resolution JPG/PNG images. No registration or software installation required.

## Quick Summary
- **Website**: https://fusiontik.vercel.app
- **Tool Type**: Web-based TikTok Downloader & Audio Converter
- **Cost**: 100% Free (No hidden fees, no subscriptions)
- **Watermark Status**: 100% No Watermark on video downloads
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero server-side file retention. Media files stream directly from TikTok CDN. Local download history remains in user's browser.
- **Device Support**: Fully responsive across Android, iOS (iPhone/iPad), Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Core Features & Formats

1. **TikTok Video Downloader (No Watermark MP4)**
   - Downloads original high-definition (HD) MP4 video without TikTok logo overlay.
   - Preserves original video resolution and framerate.

2. **TikTok Photo Mode Downloader (Carousel Images)**
   - Downloads all high-resolution JPG/PNG images from TikTok photo posts.
   - Option to save individual slides or batch download entire photo sets.

3. **TikTok MP3 Converter (Audio Extractor)**
   - Extracts and downloads high-quality MP3 background audio tracks from any TikTok post.

4. **Multi-URL Format Support**
   - Standard Web URLs: `https://www.tiktok.com/@username/video/123456789`
   - Shortened Share URLs: `https://vt.tiktok.com/ABCDEF/` or `https://vm.tiktok.com/ABCDEF/`
   - Mobile Web URLs: `https://m.tiktok.com/v/123456789.html`

## How to Download TikTok Videos on FusionTik

1. Open TikTok and copy the link of the video or photo post.
2. Visit https://fusiontik.vercel.app and paste the URL into the input box.
3. Click "Download" to process the TikTok link instantly.
4. Select your preferred output format (MP4 Video HD, MP3 Audio, or Images) to save to your device.
